note: Blossvale, on Fish Creek near Sylvan Beach/Oneida Lake, with a mile of riverfront and a private beach. An all-seasonal park with a limited number of overnight sites; some sites are on the water, so ask whether a transient waterfront site is free when reserving. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $50 overnight (W/E only) / $60 holiday weekends, $300 weekly, 100 sites, phone reservations, dump station. Added season 04-29 to 10-12 (2026), the 3-night holiday minimum as a min_stay rule, water at the site. Cleared the Good Sam directory's military discount. Note trimmed of field facts. Not stated: amperage, number of overnight sites, site lengths.
flags: Long-stay test: the rates page says 'WE ARE AN ALL SEASONAL PARK WITH A LIMITED AMOUNT OF OVERNIGHT SITES', with seasonal rates and a contract/deposit; nightly rates ARE posted ($50, no minimum outside holidays) but the number of overnight sites is not given, so the 1-in-10 test can't be confirmed. Mostly-seasonal criteria lead.
Phone: the operator's site gives 315-225-5553 ('Call to reserve your site today!'); the entry has 315-245-5228.
Price gate: base $50/night is AT, not over, US$50 (holiday weekends $60). No gateway within 40 km (nearest Thousand Islands NP 140 km); the family has not stayed here.
